# FG-GIT-0015

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 499 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`smart-http`](../../ops/runbooks/smart-http.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `client_disconnect_kills_git_and_is_git_client_disconnected` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 接続が途中で切れたため、Git の処理を中止しました。
- en: The connection was closed before the Git operation finished; it was stopped.
- id: Koneksi terputus sebelum operasi Git selesai; operasi dihentikan.

## 原因 (cause)

The client went away (or the request was cancelled) while a streaming git subprocess was running; forge killed git together with its helpers (process group / Job Object) and reaped it. The user never sees this response; the code exists for the log.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `subcommand`, `reason` (`client_disconnected` when the HTTP layer noticed, `dropped` when the request future was cancelled), `bytes_in`, `bytes_out` and `duration_ms`; `phase=request_body` (no git was started: the client went away while forge read the request body). Logged with the request id and `route`, `project_id`, `repo_id` by forge-web. Many for one client at the same byte counts point at a proxy timeout or a client-side limit; spread across clients, at network trouble.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing for an isolated case. For repeated ones, compare `duration_ms` with the proxy's timeouts (reverse proxy read/send timeout) and the client's `http.lowSpeedTime`. A receive-pack killed this way leaves no ref change; see runbook smart-http for a stale `.lock` file.
